name: Remote MCP Server (Authless)
description: Enables deployment of MCP servers on Cloudflare Workers without authentication requirements. Allows users to create custom tools and connect them to MCP clients like Claude Desktop or Cloudflare AI Playground through a remote HTTP endpoint.
